blockCause: CI infrastructure, not candidate code: npm runs unreviewed dependency install scripts with only an advisory warning, so better-sqlite3's install script fetched its prebuilt binary from github.com releases on every npm ci. The worker's direct GitHub egress returned 504s, prebuild-install fell back to node-gyp, and the agent image ships no make, so npm ci exited 1 in all three workflows (pipelines 2227 and 2228). package.json and package-lock.json are byte-identical to the R9.5 baseline (pipeline 2223 SUCCESS at 7954bd91 with the same lockfile).
fix: npm ci in all three PR workflows now pins the better-sqlite3 prebuild download to the npmmirror binary mirror via npm_config_better_sqlite3_binary_host_mirror (a native prebuild-install mirror option); npmmirror mirrors every release asset 1:1. A local Node24 full gate also exposed and fixed a staged/live pack inventory divergence in the new-workspace test staging (packed-fixture-stage.ts), which is not exercised by PR CI.
limits: Same limits as r9.5-baseline: named Demo cases are not distinct DIS requirements; later commits must not inherit PASS.
Interaction DIS020-CORE-014 stays PARTIAL: no real Chat/Form/CLI UI transport, no external download Host execution, cross-mode conformance not demonstrated.
Harness/LLM, Experience/Evolution optional profiles and governance freeze remain NOT_RUN.
